senses.gloss: ch. same, to pass by, be gone.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 2:11">Targ. Cant. II, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 9:11">Targ. Job IX, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 9:26">Ib. 26</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 12b:9">Kidd. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ אבבא וכ׳</he> went up and down in front of the house of his father-in-law (to attract the attention of his mother-in-law).
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 27:10">Targ. O. Lev. XXVII, 10</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Chullin 6b:4">Ḥull. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>חַלּוּפֵי מבעיא</he> so much the more may she be suspected of exchanging (substituting something of her own).

Meg. 7ᵇ מְחַלְּפֵי וכ׳ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8; some ed. מִיחַ׳ Ithpa.) used to exchange their meals (on Purim).—Part. pass. f. מְחַלְּפָא. Y. Peah IV, 18ᵈ bot., a. e. מח׳ שיטתיה, v. preced. Hif.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="H01098">same</cite>. Targ. O. l. c.; a. e.
to be exchanged; to change; to disappear.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 90:5">Targ. Ps. XC, 5</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78">Gen. R. s. 78</cite>, beg. <he>מִתְחַלְּפִין</he> change their names. Ḥull. l. c. <he>ולאִיחַלּוּפֵי לא וכ׳</he> Rashi (ed. <he>לחַלּוּפֵי</he>) and do we not apprehend an exchange?—Meg. l. c., v. supra.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01412"><he>חָסֵר</he> II</cite>.
